apps.localizedDescription:
"Mini Airways" is a minimalist real-time aviation management game. You’ll play as a busy air traffic controller, guiding airplanes for takeoff and landing, directing them to their destinations, and most importantly, avoiding collisions! Show off your superior commanding skills at airports around the world, such as London, Tokyo, Shanghai, Washington, and more. Use unique runway configurations and various tools to manage the airspace as long as possible in the face of increasingly dense flights.

[Game Features]
Minimalist game interface
Real-time control of flights taking off and landing
Global real-world airport maps
Classic historical events recreated
Emergency handling of unexpected incidents

[Full Content]
15 classic airports fr
